title: History Written by the Losers
coreMove: Distrust neat after-the-fact explanations and recover the practitioner logic that produced the result.
sourcePressure: This chapter argues that retrospective stories often miss what practitioners actually built and why it worked.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making this a broad anti-history complaint.
